headline: 7 stories worth your time — mostly marketing & content. Start with: How to train ChatGPT to write like you

items.title: How to train ChatGPT to write like you
items.summary: As a content creator at , I'm always looking for ways to produce more without sacrificing my voice. ChatGPT's custom instructions and the ability to build custom GPTs made it easy for me—once I figured out how to train it to actually sound like…
items.whyItMatters: Context rather than a task. Useful for deciding what to commit to next quarter and what to ignore.
actions: Practical walkthrough — read it once and decide, rather than bookmarking it.

items.title: Instagram cracks down on AI accounts pretending to be human
items.summary: Instagram is finally taking steps to address the rise of fake AI-influencer accounts that have gotten harder to spot. It's also renaming the "AI creator" label to "AI-generated profile" to make it clear when a profile features an AI-generated person that's…

items.title: ChatGPT to face tougher regulation in the EU
items.summary: OpenAI will soon be held accountable for mitigating risks related to ChatGPT's impact on minors, user mental health, and the spread of illegal content in the European Union.
items.whyItMatters: An obligation, not an opportunity. Small businesses get caught out here because nobody is watching the rules full time.
actions: Note the compliance date and check whether your business size is in scope.

items.title: Caterpillar is bringing to AI deployment what it learned from automating mining
items.summary: Caterpillar has spent decades putting autonomous machines to work at remote mining sites. It's now bringing that experience to AI deployment.
items.whyItMatters: This is back-office time. Anything here competes directly with hours you are personally spending on admin.
actions: Pick the single most repetitive task in your week and see whether this covers it end to end.

items.title: A milestone in expanding access to AI
